title: Millions of Kids Now Have Trump Accounts
summary:
The U.S. Treasury Department has made a Trump Account for every child who can have one. More than 60 million children were signed up automatically. About seven million more were already signed up by their parents after the program began in July.

A Trump Account is a kind of investment account. Money in it can grow for many years, and later it becomes a savings account for when a person retires.

There are also new rules. Donors can now give shares of single companies, called stocks. Families cannot pick or refuse these stocks, and they must keep them for five years. Before, the money only went into funds that hold small pieces of many companies.

The Treasury says the changes will bring in more gifts and help children from families with less money. Reporter Richard Rubin said the new rules are totally different from the first plan. Some experts have concerns about the stock rules.
why_it_matters: Many kids reading this may already have an account with their name on it that could grow until they are grown up.
